import pandas as pd, numpy as np, statsmodels.formula.api as smf, statsmodels.api as sm
from scipy import stats
d = pd.read_csv('/Users/lydiaashton/vib-bench-runs/runs/claude-opus-5/T4/run2/data.csv')

num = ['age','income_k','baseline_score','tenure_months','sessions_prior_30d']
bins = ['female','urban','first_gen','mobile_primary']
cats = ['region','education','employment']

print("=== BALANCE (treat vs control) ===")
for c in num+bins:
    a,b = d.loc[d.treat==1,c], d.loc[d.treat==0,c]
    t,p = stats.ttest_ind(a,b,equal_var=False)
    sd = (a.mean()-b.mean())/np.sqrt((a.var()+b.var())/2)
    print(f"{c:20s} T={a.mean():8.3f} C={b.mean():8.3f} smd={sd:+.3f} p={p:.3f}")
for c in cats:
    tab = pd.crosstab(d[c], d.treat)
    chi2,p,_,_ = stats.chi2_contingency(tab)
    print(f"{c:20s} chi2 p={p:.3f}")

print("\n=== (1) OVERALL ATE ===")
# Spec A: simple diff in means (Welch)
a,b = d.loc[d.treat==1,'outcome'], d.loc[d.treat==0,'outcome']
diff = a.mean()-b.mean()
se = np.sqrt(a.var(ddof=1)/len(a)+b.var(ddof=1)/len(b))
dfw = (a.var(ddof=1)/len(a)+b.var(ddof=1)/len(b))**2/((a.var(ddof=1)/len(a))**2/(len(a)-1)+(b.var(ddof=1)/len(b))**2/(len(b)-1))
tc = stats.t.ppf(.975,dfw)
print(f"A unadj diff-in-means: {diff:+.4f} SE={se:.4f} CI=[{diff-tc*se:+.4f},{diff+tc*se:+.4f}] p={stats.ttest_ind(a,b,equal_var=False).pvalue:.4g}")

# Spec B: OLS robust, no covariates
mB = smf.ols('outcome ~ treat', d).fit(cov_type='HC2')
print(f"B OLS HC2 no cov:      {mB.params['treat']:+.4f} SE={mB.bse['treat']:.4f} CI={np.round(mB.conf_int().loc['treat'].values,4)} p={mB.pvalues['treat']:.4g}")

# Spec C: OLS with covariates (additive), HC2
f = 'outcome ~ treat + ' + ' + '.join(num+bins) + ' + C(region)+C(education)+C(employment)'
mC = smf.ols(f, d).fit(cov_type='HC2')
print(f"C OLS +covariates:     {mC.params['treat']:+.4f} SE={mC.bse['treat']:.4f} CI={np.round(mC.conf_int().loc['treat'].values,4)} p={mC.pvalues['treat']:.4g}")

# Spec D: Lin (2013) interacted / centered covariates
dd = d.copy()
X = pd.get_dummies(dd[num+bins+cats], columns=cats, drop_first=True).astype(float)
Xc = X - X.mean()
Xc.columns = [f'v{i}' for i in range(Xc.shape[1])]
dl = pd.concat([dd[['outcome','treat']], Xc], axis=1)
fl = 'outcome ~ treat*(' + '+'.join(Xc.columns) + ')'
mD = smf.ols(fl, dl).fit(cov_type='HC2')
print(f"D Lin interacted:      {mD.params['treat']:+.4f} SE={mD.bse['treat']:.4f} CI={np.round(mD.conf_int().loc['treat'].values,4)} p={mD.pvalues['treat']:.4g}")

# Spec E: randomization inference on unadjusted diff
rng = np.random.default_rng(7)
y = d.outcome.values; t = d.treat.values
obs = diff
perm = np.array([y[(p:=rng.permutation(t))==1].mean()-y[p==0].mean() for _ in range(10000)])
print(f"E Randomization-inference p (two-sided) = {(np.abs(perm)>=abs(obs)).mean():.4f}")

# Spec F: bootstrap CI on covariate-adjusted
boot=[]
for i in range(2000):
    s = d.sample(len(d), replace=True, random_state=i)
    try: boot.append(smf.ols(f,s).fit().params['treat'])
    except Exception: pass
print(f"F Bootstrap CI (adj):  [{np.percentile(boot,2.5):+.4f},{np.percentile(boot,97.5):+.4f}]")

# Spec G: rank-based
print(f"G Mann-Whitney p={stats.mannwhitneyu(a,b).pvalue:.4g}")
print(f"\nN: T={len(a)} C={len(b)}; sd(outcome)={d.outcome.std():.3f}")
EOF

# Q: permutation null for the MAX |t| across the same 29-subgroup search (tests heterogeneity, treat reassigned)

    ts=[]
    dd=dat.copy(); dd['tr']=tcol
    def one(mask):
        s=dd[mask]
        if min((s.tr==1).sum(),(s.tr==0).sum())<20: return
        a,b=s.loc[s.tr==1,'outcome'],s.loc[s.tr==0,'outcome']
        se=np.sqrt(a.var(ddof=1)/len(a)+b.var(ddof=1)/len(b))
        ts.append(abs((a.mean()-b.mean())/se))
    for c in bins: one(dd[c]==1); one(dd[c]==0)
    for c in cats:
        for v in dd[c].unique(): one(dd[c]==v)
    for c in num:
        md=dd[c].median(); one(dd[c]>md); one(dd[c]<=md)
    return max(ts)

# Max |interaction t| across the 12 covariate-level difference tests, permutation null
